name: eval-cases
description: Turn failed agent sessions into reusable cases with source evidence and clear expected outcomes. Prepare redacted fixtures from supplied traces, conversations and configs; flag missing facts and export prepared cases using the user’s existing runner schema. No accounts or setup required for pasted inputs.
